description: This file defines a PHP class 'File' within the Opencart system, specifically for handling cache file operations such as get, set, delete, and cleanup of cache files.
published: Opencart	o	t	n	t	n\System\Library\Cache\File

classes.name: File
classes.description: Provides file-based caching mechanisms with expiration handling and automatic cleanup.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves cached data for a given key if it exists and is valid.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores data into cache with an optional expiration time.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes cache files associated with a given key.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Performs cleanup of expired cache files during object destruction, with a 1% random chance.
